source.method: Independent native-original visual transcription; exact switch and square-law checks.

Q2.scope: Dynamic evaluation starts from high precharge; undischarged output retains charge. Differential count includes explicit A/B/C complement generators for complete design.

a.scope: Literal 12-MOS extraction. P6 opposes an assumed X=0; N6 opposes X=1. This ideal switch countercheck does not prove absence of analog equilibria or determine real logic levels; device strengths and analog characterization are unprovided.

b.scope: All 12 devices retained. Columns 1/2/6 are split, supply-tied OFF isolation; no input inverter precedes a.

Q8.model: Fixed Vtn=0.6 V; pre-switch Vout=VDD; N2 at threshold onset; long-channel saturation Id=beta*(VGS-Vtn)^2/2. Body effect and channel-length modulation omitted because no parameters are supplied. No absolute beta or other threshold is assigned.
Q8.student_resistor_ratio_2: Not the square-law result: N3 has VDS=1.2 V and is saturated; constant ON-resistor division at the trip point is unjustified.

limitations: Boolean/switch and square-law analytical verification only. No process-model simulation, layout DRC, or timing characterization.
